```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(refund)
library(fda)
library(mgcv)
library(here)

```

```{r}

hr_raw <- read_csv(here("data/raw_data_110_202404/hr_raw_108.csv"))

hr_data <- hr_raw %>% 
  filter(period == "ST") %>% 
  filter(condition != "MELAS") %>% 
  mutate(group = condition,
         beat_time = rttimes.pSec) %>% 
#  select(id, beat_time, group) %>% 
  arrange(id, beat_time) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(RR = beat_time - lag(beat_time),
         HR_instant = 60 / RR) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HR_instant))

# Define a common time grid (e.g., 0.5s intervals over 5 minutes)
common_time <- seq(0, 300, by = 0.5)

# Interpolate HR onto the common time grid
hr_interpolated <- hr_data %>%
  group_by(id, group) %>%
  summarise(
    HR_interp = list(approx(x = beat_time, y = HR_instant, xout = common_time, 
                             rule = 2, method = "linear")$y)
  )

# Convert to a matrix (rows = time, cols = subjects)
HR_matrix <- do.call(cbind, hr_interpolated$HR_interp)
rownames(HR_matrix) <- common_time  

```

```{r}

library(fda)


# # Define B-spline basis for smoothing
# nbasis <- 25   # Choose based on the time window (5 min)
# basis <- create.bspline.basis(rangeval = c(0, 300), nbasis = nbasis, norder = 4)  
# 
# # Smooth HR matrix using pffr (automatic selection of penalty)
# HR_fd <- fpca.sc(Y = HR_matrix, npc = 5)  # Functional PCA to extract smooth curves


# Create B-spline basis for 5-minute interval [0,300] seconds
range <- c(0, 300)
nbasis <- 25                      # e.g. 25 basis functions for flexibility
basis <- create.bspline.basis(rangeval = range, nbasis = nbasis, norder = 4)  # cubic B-splines

# Set up functional parameter object with 2nd derivative penalty (Lfdobj=2)
lambda <- 1e-6    # initial smoothing parameter (tune via GCV in practice)
fdParObj <- fdPar(basisobj = basis, Lfdobj = 2, lambda = lambda)

# Smooth the HR data for all subjects (HR_matrix has one column per subject)
HR_fd <- smooth.basis(argvals = common_time, y = HR_matrix, fdParobj = fdParObj)$fd

fdParObj <- fdPar(basis, 2, lambda)


```

```{r}

# Create data frame with subject-level predictors
subject_info <- data.frame(id = hr_interpolated$id, group = hr_interpolated$group)

# Ensure subject order matches HR_fd
subject_info <- subject_info[order(subject_info$id),]

# Fit the function-on-scalar regression model
hr_model <- pffr(HR_fd ~ group, data = subject_info)
summary(hr_model)



```
